---
summary: Compact template for tracking implementation tasks and their acceptance evidence.
read_when:
  - Splitting an approved plan into reviewable tasks or updating task status after new evidence.
---

# [Change] tasks

- [ ] **T01 - [Outcome]**
  - Depends on: none
  - Scope: [files/symbols and bounded behavior]
  - Acceptance: [observable result]
  - Verify: `[exact command]`
  - Docs/handoff: [required update]

Update later tasks when earlier implementation changes their assumptions. A checked task must have fresh evidence, not only completed edits.
